reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isDailyWeekendSkip path with a holidays argument, and every caller (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) passes it through.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test is defined once (isNonBusinessDay) and reused by the move and the daily filters; only getDatesInRange's ad-hoc padding formula restates the lookahead idea separately from getDailySkipLookahead.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend helpers; server callers only forward their config's holidays.

scope.why: Limited to threading holidays through the date code, the type and parseRecurDate.

maintainability.why: Clear single predicate and generalised day-stepping loop; the two lookahead/padding heuristics are a bit magic.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend handling still goes through the shared helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the old weekend checks are replaced by the shared predicate.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts isNonBusinessDay (used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate and the daily filters in schedules/app.ts); window sizing is split between getDailySkipLookahead and a local padding expression in getDatesInRange.
